'''Ikhin''', or '''Arokho''', is an [[Edoid language]] of [[Edo State]], [[Nigeria]].<ref>Lewis, Ademola Anthony. 2013. ''North Edoid relations and roots''. Doctoral dissertation, University of Ibadan.</ref>

Ikhin is spoken in the Ikhin area of [[Owan East]] LGA, [[Edo State]].

Its phonology and lexicon have been described in two [[University of Ibadan]] linguistics dissertations.<ref>Oladimeji, Olaide A. 2010. ''A phonology of Ikhin, an Edoid language in South-South Nigeria''. Doctoral dissertation, University of Ibadan.</ref><ref>Folarin, Y. 1982. ''Aspects of the phonetic and phonology of Ikhin''. MA thesis, University of Ibadan.</ref>
